title: Forbidden Legend
description: Investigate the ancient legend of Archmage Gauldur, murdered by his three sons who stole his amulet of power. Track down the amulet fragments from the tombs of Mikrul in Folgunthur, Jyrik in Saarthal, and Sigdis in Geirmund's Hall, then reforge the Gauldur Amulet at Reachwater Rock.

base_facts: I am a Dunmer scholar who spent my life researching the Gauldur legend.
I traveled to Folgunthur seeking the truth about Gauldur and his three sons.
I carry the ivory dragon claw needed to open the deeper chambers of Folgunthur.

QUEST_COMPLETE: My lifelong research into the Gauldur legend has been fulfilled — the three brothers have been defeated and their father's amulet reforged at Reachwater Rock.
The ivory dragon claw I carried proved essential for reaching Mikrul Gauldurson's tomb deep within Folgunthur.
My notes revealed the full truth: Archmage Gauldur was murdered by his three sons, who divided his amulet and were hunted down by Lord Geirmund under King Harald's orders.
Though I perished in Folgunthur before completing my quest, my research and the claw I carried enabled the Gauldur Amulet to be reclaimed and restored.

beats.comment: Player discovers the Gauldur legend via a cryptic message or the book Lost Legends.
Player reaches Daynas Valen's corpse in Folgunthur and learns his findings.
Player reads Daynas Valen's notes and learns the full truth about the three brothers and the amulet fragments.
